question: Can clients pay invoices online themselves?
expected_answer: Yes. Client Portal 2.0 lets clients view their invoice history, download statements, and pay online from one self-serve page.

question: A customer sent an invoice by mistake. Can they just delete it?
expected_answer: No. Sent invoices can't be deleted; they must be voided, which keeps them in records with a VOID watermark. Only drafts can be deleted.

question: If we change our sales tax rate, do our old invoices get updated too?
expected_answer: No. A changed tax rate only applies to new invoices. Existing invoices keep the rate they were created with.

question: We bill some clients monthly on the 30th. What happens in February?
expected_answer: If a monthly schedule falls on a day that doesn't exist, like February 30, the invoice goes out on the last day of that month.

question: How well does receipt scanning work on handwritten receipts?
expected_answer: Poorly. OCR accuracy on handwritten receipts is below 40% (BUG-2100-01, Won't Fix). Typed and printed receipts scan reliably.

question: Someone on the team confirmed the wrong bank match. Can it be undone?
expected_answer: Yes. A confirmed match can be undone from the transaction's history within 30 days.

question: How long does a new user have to accept their invite?
expected_answer: The invite link expires after 7 days.
notes: Trap: the data export download link also expires in 7 days (account-billing/export-your-data). The answer must cite invite-users.

question: Can a customer switch their base currency after they've been using InvoicePilot for a while?
expected_answer: No. The base currency cannot be changed after the first transaction. To bill in other currencies, they can enable multi-currency instead.

question: A customer's integration is getting IP-4090 errors. What's going on?
expected_answer: An Idempotency-Key was reused with a different request body. It returns HTTP 409 and should not be retried.

question: A developer's API key starts with ip_test_. Is that a production key?
expected_answer: No. Keys starting with ip_test_ are for the sandbox. Production keys start with ip_live_.

question: What is BUG-2300-01, and is there a workaround?
expected_answer: Reports spanning more than 3 years of transactions time out instead of paginating. It is open. Workaround: split the report into ranges of 3 years or less, or use API v2, which pages with a cursor.

question: The API returned 503 with IP-5030. What does that mean, and should the integration retry?
expected_answer: IP-5030 means the bank feed provider is unavailable. It is retryable, with backoff.

question: Which response header tells an integration how many API calls it has left this minute?
expected_answer: X-RateLimit-Remaining. API v2 responses also include X-RateLimit-Limit and X-RateLimit-Reset.

question: Has BUG-2310-02 been fixed yet?
expected_answer: No. It is open (High) and affects 2.3.1: invoices with more than 25 line items export as a single-page PDF and drop the rest. Workaround: send by email link, or keep invoices to 25 lines or fewer.

question: Can a Professional customer set up their own user roles?
expected_answer: No. Custom roles are Enterprise only. Other plans use the four built-in roles: Admin, Accountant, Staff, and Read-only.

question: If a Starter customer emails support, how fast should they expect a reply?
expected_answer: Starter gets email support with a first response target of 2 business days.

question: Can a Professional customer have a saved report emailed to their CFO every week?
expected_answer: Yes. Scheduled report emails are available on Professional and Enterprise, including to recipients outside the organization.

question: How many API requests per minute does an Enterprise customer get?
expected_answer: 1,000 requests per minute. Enterprise customers can also ask their CSM about a custom limit.

question: Can a Starter customer design their own invoice template?
expected_answer: No. Starter includes 3 standard templates. Custom templates need Professional or Enterprise.

question: How far back does the audit log go for Enterprise customers?
expected_answer: The Enterprise audit log keeps every change for 13 months. The audit log is not available on other plans.

question: Could a customer on 2.2.0 export reports to Excel?
expected_answer: No. XLSX export arrived in 2.3.0. Before that, reports exported to PDF and CSV only.

question: A customer is still on 2.1.0. Can they send payment reminders for lots of invoices at once?
expected_answer: Not in bulk. 2.1.0 has client-level payment reminders, but sending reminders in bulk from the Invoices list arrived in 2.2.0.

question: Could a customer on 2.2.0 use automatic bank matching?
expected_answer: No. Bank reconciliation auto-match was added in 2.3.0. On 2.2.0 they would reconcile manually.

question: Which version introduced API v2?
expected_answer: API v2 was introduced in 2.2.0. API v1 is legacy but still available.

question: A Japanese customer on 2.0.0 saw yen invoice totals off by one. Was that fixed, and when?
expected_answer: Yes. BUG-2000-01, a rounding error on zero-decimal currencies like JPY, affected 2.0.0 and was fixed in 2.1.0.
